create_AudioCNN: create an AudioCNN module that processes audio spectrogram features with configurable observation space and output size
build_AudioCNN_forward: build an AudioCNN instance and run forward pass on audio observation tensors to produce embedding vectors
test_AudioCNN_init: test the AudioCNN __init__ method with small and large spectrogram dimensions to verify kernel size selection
refactor_AudioCNN_forward: refactor the AudioCNN forward method to handle multi-sensor audio input concatenation
review_AudioCNN: review the AudioCNN class and its 3-conv layer architecture with adaptive kernel sizing based on input dimensions
